summary: Loma Negra C.I.A.S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Relevant Event notice to the CNV, BYMA and A3 Mercados disclosing the closing of a public placement of Class 7 negotiable bonds (non-convertible) under its up to US$500 million program. Terms: US$150 million face value, 6.25% coupon, 100% of face value issuance price, settlement October 22, 2026, 36-month bullet maturity, semi-annual interest. No board recommendation, advisor, or equity terms disclosed. This is a routine debt capital-markets takedown, not a special situation; watch leverage and refinancing profile.
